```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(SpatialExperiment)
library(patchwork)
```

#Reading data
```{r}
bin16_list_ann <- readRDS("~/data/bin16_list_ann.rds")
```

#Main function
```{r}
plot_on_tissue <- function(spe_list, samples, genes_list, output_dir = ".") {
  
  for (gene in genes_list) {
    
    # 1. Calculate global max expression for this gene across ALL samples
    # (Required for standardizing the color scale across plots)
    max_expr <- 0
    for (spe_name in samples) {
      spe <- spe_list[[spe_name]]
      if (gene %in% rownames(spe)) {
        val <- max(logcounts(spe)[gene, ], na.rm = TRUE)
        if (val > max_expr) max_expr <- val
      }
    }
    
    plot_list <- list()
    
    # 2. Build spatial plot for each sample
    for (spe_name in samples) {
      spe <- spe_list[[spe_name]]
      
      if (!gene %in% rownames(spe)) {
        message(paste("Skipping:", gene, "not in", spe_name))
        next
      }
      
      coords <- as.data.frame(spatialCoords(spe))
      colnames(coords)[1:2] <- c("x_coord", "y_coord")
      coords$expr <- as.numeric(logcounts(spe)[gene, ])
      
      p <- ggplot(coords, aes(x = x_coord, y = y_coord, color = expr)) +
        geom_point(size = 0.5) +
        coord_fixed() +
        scale_y_reverse() +
        ggtitle(spe_name) +
        theme_void() +
        theme(
          plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
          legend.title = element_blank()
        ) +
        # Set fixed upper limit (max_expr) for accurate cross-sample comparison
        scale_color_gradientn(
          colors = rev(hcl.colors(9, "Rocket")),
          limits = c(0, max_expr)
        )
      
      plot_list[[spe_name]] <- p
    }
    
    # 3. Combine sample plots into one multi-panel figure per gene
    if (length(plot_list) > 0) {
      combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = length(plot_list)) +
        plot_layout(guides = "collect") + # Share a single legend
        plot_annotation(title = paste("Gene:", gene), 
                        theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")))
      
      # Save comparison image
      file_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("compare_", gene, ".png"))
      ggsave(
        filename = file_path, 
        plot = combined_plot, 
        width = 3.5 * length(plot_list) + 1, 
        height = 4, 
        dpi = 300
      )
    }
  }
}
```


```{r}
c26_samples <- c("c26_b2","c26_b4","c26_b6")
sham_samples <- c("sham_b1","sham_b3","sham_b6")
c26_sham <- c(c26_samples,sham_samples)
genes_axone_guidance <- c("Sema6a", "Sema6b", "Sema3f", "Sema3a", "Sema4g", "Sema3e", "Sema4f", "Sema3c",
                          "Sema4a", "Sema7a", "Sema4b", "Sema5a", "Sema4c", "Sema5b", "Sema6d", "Sema4d",
                          "Sema6c", "Nrp1", "Nrp2", "Plxnb2", "Plxna2", "Plxnb3", "Plxnb1")
plot_on_tissue(bin16_list_ann, c26_sham, genes_axone_guidance)

```
